make_atari_env: create an Atari environment with NoopResetEnv and MaxAndSkipEnv wrappers using make_atari
wrap_deepmind_env: wrap an Atari environment with DeepMind-style preprocessing including frame stacking and reward clipping
wrap_pytorch_env: wrap an environment to transpose image observations from HWC to CHW format for PyTorch
use_FrameStack_wrapper: stack the last k frames into a single observation using the FrameStack wrapper
use_WarpFrame_wrapper: warp environment frames to 84x84 grayscale using the WarpFrame observation wrapper
